module: Flowgraph node "End Stats" (category repeat_instant): gathers the statistics to display on the end screen. For each statistic i: inputs "label_i" (string or translationObject table), "points_i", "maxPoints_i". Hidden input "statData" (previous list) and output "statData" (endStats table) to connect to End Screen, optionally chaining several nodes.
notes: Each statistic also adds relativePoints = points*100/maxPoints when points and maxPoints exist (division by zero if maxPoints = 0).
The minimum counter in the editor is 1 (ptr < 1 -> 1), whereas count is 0 at initialization.
work() adds elements to the input table statData (modified in place) every frame.

drawCustomProperties.desc: "Count" field for the number of statistics.

builder.desc: Editor node builder (builder:Middle() opens the central area).

style.desc: Node display style provided by the editor.

updatePins.desc: Adjusts the number of groups of 3 input pins (label, points, maxPoints).

work.desc: Takes the input list, adds an entry {label, points, maxPoints, relativePoints} per statistic and writes it to "statData".
